bills.title: Treasury Laws Amendment (News Media Bargaining) (Consequential) Bill 2026

name: Sue Lines Pursuant to order agreed on 18 August 2026, the time allotted for consideration of 12 bills has expired. I'll now put the question on the remaining stages of the bills. The question is that the second reading amendment on sheet 4012, to the News Media Bargaining (Administration) Bill 2026 and related bills, be agreed to.
